/cc @apelisse 
could you please take a look

/triage accepted

I have run into this issue and was a bit surprised. The default "fieldValidation" should be WARN according to the documentation, but this is just a plain error. 

Shouldn't the "fieldValidation" be accepted in this case? It seems to be the case of _kubectl_.
@TomCools Are you running apply? Because Apply doesn't have a "WARN" mode, it just can't function with unknown fields. Maybe we should clarify the documentation.

@cici37 yep, I will continue on it. I reopened my PR and some integration tests need to be added.

review_comments: is this always a bad request or could it be an internal error? I can't tell where the fault lies if this encounters an error
this also needs a test (probably an integration test) demonstrating the issue being fixed

Yeah, it's very likely to be a bad request if that specific line fails, it might fail for other reasons and we may want to check that but I think BadRequest is a better default than arbitrary 500 failure. We could look into `ObjectToTyped` more specifically to find what are the other ways it can fail, and see if we can distinguish the two somehow.
